_doc: tools/import_boss_frames.gd reads this (see its header and README.txt here): one sheet per animation (frames side by side in one row on magenta, facing right) → assets/bosses/ice_witch/side/<anim>_<i>.png + side.json; pictures → assets/bosses/ice_witch/<name>.png. height: the body (hood top to the frost-mist hem's bottom) in texture px, every animation; background: tools/import_frames.gd key_background() options (an anim's own background merged over it); despill.hueRange: the magenta-tinted px turn grey; body: the cloak's colours (hue range, minSat, minVal, maxVal) the frames are measured by; per anim: src, frames (how many), fps, loop, peak (the frame of its effect's peak), watermark [[x, y, r]] (sheet px: the ✦ painted out), cuts [x, ...] (sheet px: the frame boundaries, else found at the empty columns), edgeFade (px faded at a cut through an effect), bodyHeight (sheet px, else the frames' median), scale (× the normalised size), anchors [[x, y] | null] (sheet px: a frame's feet), compose {'i': [j, ...]} (frame i = the parts j... as the sheet has them, on the first one's feet: the cast's flash where her staff points); tone: the lift on every frame and picture (lighten: OKHSL lightness, this share of the way to white, the darks most; desaturateDark: the darkest tones this much less saturated; the black outline untouched).
